summary: Attribute conversation relay latency to bounded owner identities and sampled owner read phases. Owner labels admit only Config.peers plus the local node; discovered or unconfigured owners collapse to unknown without new configuration.

replay.detail: Telemetry only; no stored claims are rewritten.

schema.detail: No database schema or SQL changes.

rules.detail: No coordination or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing read responses and wire contracts are unchanged; adds a bounded relay histogram and sampled request attributes.

manual.detail: Existing telemetry configuration exports the new instrumentation.

recovery.detail: Previous binaries can read all unchanged state.
